parameters.query:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    session_id,
    message->>'type' AS msg_type,
    message->>'content' AS msg_content,
    created_at,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY id DESC) AS rn
  FROM clinica_zen
),
last_human AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (session_id)
         session_id,
         msg_content AS last_human_content,
         created_at  AS last_human_at
  FROM ranked
  WHERE msg_type = 'human'
  ORDER BY session_id, created_at DESC
)
SELECT r.session_id
FROM ranked r
LEFT JOIN last_human h ON h.session_id = r.session_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
  AND r.msg_type = 'ai'
  AND r.created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '60 minutes'
  AND r.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM reenganches x
    WHERE x.session_id = r.session_id
      AND x.status IN ('sent', 'lead_not_found')
      AND x.attempted_at >= COALESCE(h.last_human_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz)
  )
  AND (
    h.last_human_content IS NULL
    OR trim(lower(h.last_human_content)) !~ '^(gracias|muchas gracias|vale[, ]*gracias|perfecto[, ]*gracias|ok[, ]*gracias|genial[, ]*gracias|de acuerdo|adi[oó]s|hasta luego|chao|nada m[aá]s|no,? *gracias|no,? *nada m[aá]s)\W*$'
  )
LIMIT 5

parameters.query:
WITH mark AS (
  INSERT INTO reenganches (session_id, status, attempted_at, last_error)
  VALUES ($1, 'sent', NOW(), NULL)
  ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE
    SET status = 'sent', attempted_at = NOW(), last_error = NULL
  RETURNING session_id
)
INSERT INTO clinica_zen (session_id, message)
SELECT $1, jsonb_build_object(
         'type', 'ai',
         'content', '¿Sigues por ahí? Si tienes alguna pregunta o necesitas algo más, aquí estoy.',
         'additional_kwargs', '{}'::jsonb,
         'response_metadata', '{}'::jsonb)
FROM mark
RETURNING id

INSERT INTO reenganches (session_id, status, attempted_at, last_error)
VALUES ($1, 'lead_not_found', NOW(), 'Kommo 400: Lead not found')
ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE
  SET status = 'lead_not_found', attempted_at = NOW(), last_error = EXCLUDED.last_error
RETURNING session_id

INSERT INTO reenganches (session_id, status, attempted_at, last_error)
VALUES ($1, 'error', NOW(), $2)
ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE
  SET status = 'error', attempted_at = NOW(), last_error = EXCLUDED.last_error
RETURNING session_id
